name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's journey into motorsport was an unexpected turn from his initial culinary ambitions. Starting in a humble family restaurant, Wei honed his skills in crafting authentic Cantonese cuisine. A chance encounter catering for a local racing team sparked an interest in the fast-paced world of motorsport. He found the challenge of providing high-quality, nutritious meals under pressure exhilarating.

Wei joined Hitech GP five years ago and has since revolutionized their catering operation. His approach blends traditional Chinese culinary techniques with modern nutritional science, ensuring the team's dietary needs are met with both flavor and efficiency. Wei's dedication to sourcing fresh, local ingredients and his ability to adapt to the demanding schedules of the racing season make him an invaluable asset to the team. His calm demeanor even during the most hectic race weekends sets him apart, ensuring the team is well-fed and focused.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Wei is of average height, with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down new recipe ideas.
Insists on brewing his own special blend of green tea for the team every morning.
Secretly practices Tai Chi in the catering truck before each race.
